title: Editor Crash when creating scene from existing Camera2D
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.5-stable, 4.6-stable, 4.7 master branch
- Not reproducible in 3.6-stable, 4.0-stable, 4.1-stable, 4.2-stable, 4.3-stable, 4.4-stable

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev (f4f0679a2) - Fedora Linux 42 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 (nvidia; 580.82.07) - AMD Ryzen 9 5900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads) - 31.25 GiB memory

### Issue description

### Steps to reproduce

Steps to reproduce on new project:

1. Click 2D Scene to create new root node, do not save.
2. Right-click Node2D in scene tree to "Add Child Node..."
3. Select Camera2D and add it to the scene, do not save.
4. Right-click Camera2D in scene tree to "Save Branch as Scene..."
5. In the resulting modal window for "Save New Scene As..." just press the "Save" button

After several seconds, the editor crashes with a stack trace.
